$comment: Safe (Gnosis Safe) singleton addresses from safe-global/safe-deployments (src/assets/v1.1.1, v1.3.0, v1.4.1; canonical, EIP-155 and zkSync variants), read 2026-10-23. A holder whose storage slot 0 points at one of these is a Safe proxy. Lower-case. `proxy_runtime_prefix` is the functional runtime code of GnosisSafeProxy/SafeProxy (v1.1.1, v1.3.0, v1.4.1 share it; only the solc CBOR metadata after the 0xfe byte differs), read from live proxies 0x849D5231... (1.3.0) and 0xf32c2058... (1.4.1) and the v1.1.1 factory creation code on 2026-10-23. A holder is a Safe proxy only when its code is this prefix + 0xfe + metadata AND slot 0 holds a published singleton.
